=== Mod-Backspace deletes back to the content start and keeps the box
--- given
- [ ] abc‸
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then
- [ ] ‸

=== Mod-Backspace at the content start swallows the key
--- given
- [ ] ‸abc
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then consumed
- [ ] ‸abc

=== Mod-Backspace on a notes line stops at its indent
--- given
- a
  no‸te
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then
- a
  ‸te

=== Mod-Backspace after the bullet only treats the box as content
--- given stick=bullet-only
- [ ] ab‸
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then
- ‸

=== Mod-Backspace with a selection passes to the editor
--- given
- ⟨ab⟩c
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then passthrough
- ⟨ab⟩c

=== Mod-Backspace in the middle of the content keeps the tail
--- given
- abc‸def
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then
- ‸def

=== Mod-Backspace passes to the editor when the cursor is not kept in the content
--- given stick=never
- abc‸
--- when key Mod-Backspace
--- then passthrough
- abc‸
